pieces.Text: A sandman radiates a 20-foot-radius spread that puts creatures to sleep.  Any creature in the area must succeed on a DC

Will save or fall asleep, as if affected by a sleep spell (caster level 8th).  There is no limit to the number of Hit Dice a sandman can affect with this ability.  A creature that successfully saves is immune to that sandman's sleep aura for 24 hours.
